purpose: Central registry/router for external model weights and adapters. GitHub stores references and evidence, not model weights.

storage_policy.secret_policy: Secrets must remain in GitHub Secrets/provider secret storage; never commit them.

binding_rule: No SAPHEA becomes BOUND from a registry entry alone. Real availability plus benchmark and audit are required.
independence_rule: Same base model, adapter, prompt/data lineage or shared evidence must be recorded and must not be counted automatically as independent reproduction.
cache_policy: Runtime cache is ephemeral unless explicitly approved; never commit downloaded weights to Git.
